莉莉的生活方式(Lily's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:莉莉的经历、感受与成长。
At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. Little by little, things began to change. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Xi'an. What's more, small farms face thin profit margins.

Lily keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. The city library has become an important part of daily life. People around Lily often share different ideas about the subway station. The top debater will make mincemeat of her opponents.

Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Best of all, the sugar tax reshaped soft-drink recipes.

The subway station looked quieter than usual that evening. On Sunday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Check the parking meter before you leave the car.
Lily will take part in a badminton match in November. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Lily thanked Sam for the honest advice.
